tests.scenario: T7.1 Rebalance satisfies ΣΔw = 0 (mass conservation; no bar duplication)
tests.reason: Optimizer budget constraint: total weight change = 0. Adding to GoldTok requires reducing another asset.

tests.scenario: T7.2 Acquiring GoldTok = fiat→PAXG swap (asset substitution, not gold creation)
tests.reason: MITHQAL buys PAXG on secondary market using fiat. The gold backing PAXG was already allocated by Paxos; MITHQAL does not re-claim it as physical. The two bar pools remain legally separated.

tests.scenario: T8.1 GoldPhys bar serials ≠ GoldTok bar serials (disjoint allocated pools)
tests.reason: MITHQAL physical bars (Brink's/Loomis vault) and PAXG backing bars (Paxos LBMA vault) are in different custodies. Serial-number sets are disjoint.

tests.scenario: T8.2 Independent attestation reports cover GoldPhys and GoldTok SEPARATELY
tests.reason: GoldPhys: MITHQAL's own auditor (e.g., big-4). GoldTok: Paxos's auditor (Withum, monthly). Two separate attestation chains — no consolidation that could mask overlap.

tests.scenario: T9.1 GoldShareWithinBullion = Gold_total / Bullion_total (not GoldPhys alone)
T9.2 When Silver admitted, GoldShare ≥ 70% (§V24.2.1.4 governance threshold)
T10.1 REJECTED: counting GoldTok as both physical and tokenized (triple-count)
tests.reason: Tokenized gold is counted ONCE, as GoldTok. It is NOT also added to GoldPhys.

tests.scenario: T10.2 REJECTED: rehypothecating GoldTok as collateral for GoldPhys acquisition
tests.reason: GoldTok is held as a reserve asset, not posted as collateral. No rehypothecation (eligibility condition #6).

tests.scenario: T10.3 REJECTED: folding GoldTok market value into GoldPhys before GEI
tests.reason: GEI sums distinct asset rows. GoldTok is its own row.
